+from itertools import product
+
+
+def _dependency_solver(data, preference, name_order):
+    packages = data["packages"]
+    names = sorted(packages)
+    roots = data["roots"]
+    features = set(data.get("features", []))
+    blocked = data.get("blocked", {})
+    pins = data.get("pins", {})
+    rows_by_name = {
+        name: {row["version"]: row for row in rows}
+        for name, rows in packages.items()
+    }
+    best_vector = None
+    best_versions = None
+
+    for assignment in product(*[[-1] + list(rows_by_name[name]) for name in names]):
+        versions = {name: version for name, version in zip(names, assignment)
+                    if version != -1}
+        if any(name not in versions or not low <= versions[name] <= high
+               for name, (low, high) in roots.items()):
+            continue
+        if any(version in blocked.get(name, []) for name, version in versions.items()):
+            continue
+        if any(versions[name] != pin for name, pin in pins.items()
+               if name in versions):
+            continue
+
+        edges = {name: [] for name in versions}
+        valid = True
+        for name, version in versions.items():
+            row = rows_by_name[name][version]
+            for dep in row.get("deps", []):
+                feature = dep.get("feature", "")
+                if feature and feature not in features:
+                    continue
+                target = dep["name"]
+                if (target not in versions or
+                        not dep["min"] <= versions[target] <= dep["max"]):
+                    valid = False
+                    break
+                edges[name].append(target)
+            if not valid:
+                break
+        if not valid:
+            continue
+
+        # Installed packages must be precisely the dependency closure of roots.
+        reachable = set()
+        stack = list(roots)
+        while stack:
+            name = stack.pop()
+            if name in reachable:
+                continue
+            reachable.add(name)
+            stack.extend(edges[name])
+        if reachable != set(versions):
+            continue
+
+        state, acyclic = {}, True
+
+        def visit(name):
+            nonlocal acyclic
+            if state.get(name) == 1:
+                acyclic = False
+                return
+            if state.get(name) == 2:
+                return
+            state[name] = 1
+            for target in edges[name]:
+                visit(target)
+                if not acyclic:
+                    return
+            state[name] = 2
+
+        for name in versions:
+            visit(name)
+            if not acyclic:
+                break
+        if not acyclic:
+            continue
+
+        ordered = names if name_order == "ascending" else list(reversed(names))
+        vector = tuple(versions.get(name, -1) for name in ordered)
+        if (best_vector is None or
+                (vector < best_vector if preference == "minimum"
+                 else vector > best_vector)):
+            best_vector = vector
+            best_versions = versions
+
+    return {"versions": best_versions} if best_versions is not None else {"error": "unsatisfiable"}
+
